design.purpose: A drained outdoor planter for herbs or flowers for one household. Interior is about 36 × 16 cm and 18 cm deep, giving at least 15 cm soil depth.

steps.c: Place the 120 cm wide board flat for cutting
Cut a 40 cm base; keep the 79.7 cm remainder
Place the 120 cm board flat for cutting
Sand the cut ends of all five planter parts
Place the 40 cm base flat on the floor
Drill four drainage holes through the base
Stand the front wall on the base front edge
Stand the back wall on the base back edge
Fit the left end between front and back
Fit the right end between front and back
Screw the front wall to the left end
Screw the front wall to the right end
Screw the back wall to the left end
Screw the back wall to the right end
Screw upward through base into front wall
Screw upward through base into back wall
